title: erysimum capitatum var. lompocense
intro: Erysimum capitatum var. lompocense, commonly known as Lompoc wallflower, is a plant species that belongs to the Brassicaceae family. It is native to the western United States and has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Lompoc wallflower include wound healing, skin protection, and the treatment of respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and coughs. The bioactive constituents of Erysimum capitatum var. lompocense include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
